semanticText:
# Order with Seller Decision

Adds a seller rejection decision to an Order with Clauses. `/orderDecision/status` starts as PENDING. Acceptance uses the Order's normal Activation workflow, so PENDING by itself only describes the rejection record.

Only the seller can call `rejectOrder`. The call references the exact reviewed document version and supplies the current activation `revision`. A changed revision or seller approval rejects the call. An already-rejected Order makes no further change after those guards pass. A successful rejection records REJECTED with the activation revision and terms reference and emits Order rejected.

The dispatch policy blocks the external Activation approval operations after rejection, including the applicable negotiation-and-activation operations. The rejection records an Order decision. A payment effect requires its own configured process and confirmation.
